name: scripted-deploy
goal: Build a script-only Docker deployment command with exact release gates and prove the authorized Fluora staging path.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Approved tracker item 56x4kx at 20:45 UTC. Confirmed Fluora staging Pages project fluora-next-stage, provider deployment d54e8702 and main-within-Pages branch. Production maps to fluora-next; no Fluora Next preprod is declared. CLI must fail closed while the broker has no staging action.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Guarded CLI, ARM64 runner, immutable build input and release identity, migration drift gate, and Fluora phase scripts implemented. Capability bridge and live staging rollout remain gated.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Six focused deployment unit tests and three repository contract guard suites passed in a 22-test run. Seven CLI E2Es passed on harbor-mbp-2, covering signed promotion, drift, malformed and expired approvals, artifact tampering and rollback recovery.
